senses.gloss: to assume importance, to allow one’s self to be coaxed; to decline an office.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 86b:9">Pes. 86ᵇ</cite> <he>מְסָרְבִין לקטן וכ׳</he> you may decline an offer from an inferior person than yourself, but not &c.

<cite ref="Berakhot 34a:4">Ber. 34ᵃ</cite> … <he>העובר צריך לסָרֵב</he> he who is asked to say the prayers, must first decline (wait to be asked again); <he>ואם אינו מְסָרֵב וכ׳</he> and if he does not decline, he is like a dish without salt; <he>ואם מסרב יותר מדאי וכ׳</he> but if he allows himself to be coaxed more than proper &c.

<cite ref="Berakhot 34a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>פעם ראשונה יְסָרֵב וכ׳</he> when asked for the first time, he must decline, the second time &c., v. <cite ref="E00029"><he>הִבְהֵב</he></cite>; Y. ib. V, 9ᶜ bot. <he>בתחלה מסרב וכ׳</he>.

senses.gloss: (with ב; v. סִרְהֵב) [to be imperious,] to press, urge.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 4:3:6">Y. Dem. IV, 24ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>לא יְסָרֵב וכ׳</he> one must not urge his neighbor to be his guest, when he knows that he will not accept; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 7:8">Tosef. B. Kam. VII, 8</cite> <he>המְסָרֵב בחבירו וכ׳</he> he who urges his neighbor to be his guest, when in his heart he does not mean to invite him; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:3:3">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᶜ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 6:14">Tosef. B. Bath. VI, 14</cite>; <cite ref="Tractate Derekh Eretz Rabbah 8:4">Treat. Der. Er. ch. VIII</cite>; (<cite ref="Chullin 94a:10">Ḥull. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>יסרהב</he>).
<cite ref="Tosefta Nedarim 4">Tosef. Ned. IV</cite>, 8ᵃ; <cite ref="Nedarim 21a">Ned. 21</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:16:1">Koh. R. to I, 16</cite> <he>הלב מסרב וכ׳</he> the heart is rebellious, as we read (<cite ref="Jeremiah 5:23">Jer. V, 23</cite>). Midr, Till. to <cite ref="Psalms 5:11">Ps. V, 11</cite> (expl. <he>מרו</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 5:11">ib.</cite>) <he>שסֵרְבוּ כנגדך</he> ed. Bub. (oth. ed. <he>שרבו</he>, corr. acc.) they rebelled against thee; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 632">Yalk. ib. 632</cite>; a. e.
